summary: Iteration-7 testing for VIRTUE FPS: avatar idx 0-5 (was 0-4), banner persistence, public_user schema (banner_icon/banner_color/peak_rank_tier), kill-event new shooter_* fields, PlayerCard BannerStrip on lobby, AvatarPicker with 6 options + Peak Crest idx 5, RankCard tier icons, SettingsModal advanced sections (keybinds/controller/mobile HUD), keybind rebinding flow + HUD layout persistence to localStorage. Backend: 16/16 pytest passing (incl. live WS kill-event schema). Frontend: end-to-end login + lobby banner + profile picker + settings advanced sections + /play offline map render all working with zero JS errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:89-116 public_user() correctly exposes banner_icon, banner_color, peak_rank_tier as int-coerced fields with sane defaults (0). peak_rank_points monotonically rises to max(points, peak) which is exactly the right semantic for a 'peak' field.

server.py:458-466 AvatarIn(ge=0,le=5) Pydantic constraint cleanly upgrades the previous 0..4 range; idx=6 returns 422 with FastAPI's default validation error envelope (verified). No DB migration needed since existing avatar=0..4 docs remain valid.

server.py:470-483 BannerIn(0..7, 0..7) — both icon and color are independently validated; storage is via $set so no stale fields. public_user re-reads from DB-returned dict so the response always reflects persisted state.

server.py:684-693 Player.__init__ defensively coerces avatar/banner/peak_rank_tier with `int(... or 0)` and falls back to current rank tier when peak is missing — correctly prevents NoneType crashes for old user docs.

server.py:1049-1065 (melee kill) and 1141-1157 (ranged kill) — kill event payload now includes shooter_peak_rank_tier, shooter_banner_icon, shooter_banner_color via `getattr(... , default)`. Verified live in TestKillEventSchema (bots fight bots in casual room, event keys+int-types present).

PlayerCard.jsx:88 BannerStrip with data-testid='player-card-banner' renders only when bannerIcon AND bannerColor are finite numbers (Number.isFinite guard) — verified visible in lobby-user-card. Good defensive null-handling.

Profile.jsx:302-343 AvatarPicker has 6 options (AVATAR_COUNT=6); idx=5 is the 'Peak Crest' which uses peakTier prop and rankIconFor() for dynamic rendering. Save indicator + check mark + aria-pressed semantics are correct. Note: child `<Avatar testid='avatar-option-N-avatar' />` causes prefix-selector `[data-testid^="avatar-option-"]` to over-match (12 vs 6) — not a bug, but tests should use exact selectors.
Profile.jsx:269-291 RankCard renders the tier icon via rankIconFor(tier) into <I/> with data-testid={testid}-icon — both 'profile-current-rank-icon' and 'profile-peak-rank-icon' visible in test.

AdvancedControls.jsx:115-145 KeybindsSection — listening state via local useState, click sets it, key handler updates bind + clears listening, ESC clears. The button text is uppercased via CSS so any case-sensitive selector must account for 'PRESS KEY…'. Suggest adding a separate data-testid for the listening label (e.g., 'settings-keybind-forward-status') if tests want to assert it cleanly.

AdvancedControls.jsx:250-330 MobileHudSection writes through settingsStore — confirmed localStorage 'virtue-settings-v1' now contains hudLayout.actions.{x,y,scale,opacity} after dragging Offset X to 60. Sliders correctly use independent testids per element (`settings-hud-x-actions`, etc.) so multi-element coverage is testable.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 — 6 avatar range + 2 422 guards + 4 banner range + 1 public_user schema + 1 live kill-event WS + 2 smoke regression)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on functional checks (banner strip on lobby PlayerCard, settings modal advanced sections present, keybind listening + key-press rebind + ESC cancel, mobile HUD slider drag + localStorage persistence, profile AvatarPicker with 6 options + click idx=5 fires POST + selected state, rank icons present, /play offline initializes engine with no JS errors)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_banner_avatar_kill.py -v -c /app/backend/tests/pytest.ini --tb=short`. Kill-event schema test relies on casual-room bots fighting; if bot AI ever becomes more passive, the test will gracefully pytest.skip rather than fail. Note: profile AvatarPicker uses `data-testid^="avatar-option-"` for both the parent button AND a child <Avatar testid='avatar-option-N-avatar'> — when counting picker options use exact selector `[data-testid="avatar-option-N"]` not prefix. Keybind row text is uppercased via CSS — assert with case-insensitive match or use the text after a key press to verify state transitions.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Two false-negative test lines in the Playwright run were due to overly-greedy CSS prefix selector and case-sensitive text match; underlying features verified correct via follow-up assertions and localStorage inspection.
